provenance.note: The constants below are hand-set from the cited reference cases and from published literature. No least-squares fit against the reference cases has been run, so no constant here is a fitted value and the engine reports calibration_fitted as false. `anchor` names the reference cases a constant was set against; it must name only cases that still exist in validation/anchors, or "none".
provenance.reference_cases: SOLIT2 Engineering Guidance Annex 2, full-scale fire tests c4 (Class A with cover), c5 (Class A without cover) and c6 (Class B diesel pools).

pool_ramp_s.note: Annex 2: pools need 2-3 min to develop

pool_extinction_time_s.note: per pool; Annex 2: extinguished pool by pool

critical_velocity_height.note: H in Li-Ingason; mean height gives ~5% lower u_c

flame_length_coefficient.note: C_f, Ingason & Li, Tunnel Fire Dynamics ch.11

eta_max.note: SOLIT2 held a 150 MW potential load to ~30 MW, so the ceiling is at least 0.80

w_ref_mm_min.note: basis removed with c1-c3; refit required. Was set against reference cases c1, c2 and c3, none of which survive in validation/anchors, so this value currently rests on nothing and is carried unchanged only to avoid silently altering the physics.

chi_cool_max.note: basis removed with c3; refit required. This value has no surviving reference case and is carried unchanged pending a refit against c4-c6.

evaporation_k_ref_m2s.note: basis removed with c3; refit required. d-squared law constant at the reference gas temperature rise; a 100 um drop evaporates in ~0.1 s at that rise and essentially not at all in cool air. The magnitude is physically reasonable but the specific value was set against c3, which no longer exists.

evaporation_reference_delta_t_k.note: basis removed with c3; refit required. Paired with evaporation_k_ref_m2s and set against the same deleted reference case.
